title: Words Starting with a Vowel Containing a Digit
description:
Some dictionary entries have been corrupted with digits. Find every word that **starts with a vowel** (a, e, i, o, u — case-insensitive) **and** contains **at least one digit anywhere** in it.

Use `REGEXP_LIKE(word, ...)` — note the pattern does NOT need anchors here because you are matching a *property* of the string, not the whole string. Name the columns `id` and `word`. Return rows in any order.
hint: This needs two separate patterns joined with AND: `^[aeiou]` checks the first character (unanchored at the end, so the rest can be anything), and `[0-9]` finds any digit. REGEXP_LIKE is case-insensitive by default here, so 'Apple2' matches.
outputExplanation: 'elephant5' starts with e and contains a 5. 'zebra2' has a digit but starts with z. 'apple' starts with a vowel but has no digit. 'X1' starts with a consonant.
